title: fix: When `experimental/serverStatus` is not supported by the client, only update the status if the message is different

target.summary: Because self.last_reported_status is updated to status earlier in update_status_or_notify, self.last_reported_status.message != status.message always evaluates to false. Consequently, warning and error status notifications are never displayed to clients that do not support experimental/serverStatusNotification.
notes: faulty condition; self.last_reported_status was already updated to status earlier in update_status_or_notify so this comparison always evaluates to false
